description: Resolve a data model reference (ID or title) to a concrete data model ID and title.

datamodel_ref.description: Data model reference to resolve. This can be either an ID or a name.

examples.user_query: What is the ID and title of the data model named 'Sales Analytics'?
examples.notes: This call resolves the data model reference 'Sales Analytics' to its concrete ID and title. Use this when you know the name of the data model but need its ID.

examples.user_query: Find the details of the data model with ID '12345abc'.
examples.notes: This call resolves the data model reference '12345abc' to its concrete ID and title. Use this when you have the ID of the data model but need its title or to confirm its existence.

examples.user_query: I need to verify if the data model titled 'Marketing Insights' exists and retrieve its ID.
examples.notes: This call checks if the data model titled 'Marketing Insights' exists and retrieves its ID and title. Use this when you have the title of the data model and need to confirm its details.
